outcome: Referral to other multidisciplinary support services
cohort: 194 women with complex social factors in the UK
finding: Caseload midwifery care was associated with a higher likelihood of spontaneous vaginal childbirth, water birth, shorter postnatal stay, and fewer caesarean sections, epidurals, and neonatal unit admissions compared to standard maternity care.
mod_finding: Women receiving caseload midwifery care were more likely to experience spontaneous vaginal childbirth and less likely to have a cesarean section compared to those receiving standard maternity care.
